description: This file defines server-side logic for a public estimate portal in a SvelteKit application. It includes a load function to fetch and process estimate data via a token, and actions to accept or decline the estimate. The file facilitates public viewing and interaction with estimates without authentication.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches estimate data based on token, handles errors, and returns estimate details and optional template styling.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Handles the API call to accept an estimate based on the provided token, returns success or failure status.

methods.name: decline
methods.description: Handles the API call to decline an estimate based on the provided token, returns success or failure status.
